description: Live scores / matches for a sport on a date or league. Returns id, home/away teams, score, status, kickoff date, and league. Example: highlightly_matches({ sport: "football", date: "2026-05-01", _apiKey: "your-key" })

date.description: Match date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-05-01" (optional)

leagueId.description: Numeric league ID to filter by (optional)

sport.description: Sport slug that selects the API path prefix. Default "football" (association football / soccer). Other values: "basketball", "hockey", "baseball", "rugby", "volleyball". "soccer" is normalized to "football".

name: highlightly_matches
title: Highlightly Matches
